_doc: Pre-registered carried-STOP set for B2 (§3.4). Declared NOW on the v31-on-n=1 baseline to avoid hindsight risk (declaring at B2 adjudication = the same NEW-1 pathology). Source = b1p_og_e2000_v31regression/og_gate.json.
rule: §3.4 phase-class: a DECOUPLED-phase STOP = carried = exempt-if-persist in B2 (DR structurally cannot move it; the rollout's seat-verified pin confirms actual funneling). MOVABLE {0-3} + C2_REGRASP (b)-pair = NOT-exempt (these are what DR must fix; persistence in B2 = a REAL STOP that blocks). OG-a decode STOPs classify by the SAME phase-class of their phase.

carried_exempt_detail.note: funnels to fixed C2; DR cannot move it -> exempt-if-persist

b2_usage: og_offline_gate.py --carried-stops GUIDE_C2  (only DECOUPLED-phase names are honored by the gate; movable/cable STOPs can NEVER be carried by construction).
